title: Madagascar The Musical
subtitle: This lively, high-energy production is crack-a-lackin' entertainment for all the family.
altText: Madagascar the musical cast on stage
summary: It’s crack-a-lackin' entertainment for all the family! This high-energy show is the perfect length for a younger audience.
bodyHtml:
Natural food chains don’t matter when you live in luxury at New York’s Central Park Zoo. Best friends Alex the Lion and Marty the Zebra have everything they need...

The musical production showcases a fantastic mix of theatrical puppetry, mixed in with the main characters in full costumes.
tips: Pacing: A lively, high-energy production with an upbeat score.
Loud noises: Expect some loud roars as you explore the jungles of Madagascar.

title: Black Power Desk
subtitle: We are human first!
altText: Celia and Dina sit next to the title Black Power Desk
summary: Powerful and gripping, Black Power Desk tells the story of two sisters battling racial oppression in 1970's London.
bodyHtml: Black Power Desk is an extraordinary work of art, a retelling of history and yet devastatingly relevant today.
tips: Content Advisory: Contains strong, discriminatory language and depictions of violence.

title: The Boy At The Back Of The Class
subtitle: Thought provoking tale of courage, friendship and compassion.
altText: Book cover image The Boy at the back of the Class
summary: The Boy at the Back of the Class is an award-winning book that tells the story of a 9-year-old refugee arriving in the UK.
bodyHtml: Written by Onjali Q. Raúf, adapted for a live audience by Nick Ahad and directed by Monique Touko, this is one of the most powerful pieces of theatre I have ever seen.
tips: Running Time: Approx. 2 hours (including an interval).
Pacing: A story-driven play focusing on dialogue, mystery, and character.
Themes & Tone: Sensitively tackles serious themes including the refugee experience.
